summaries.senate: Polymarket odds show a sizable rise in the Democrats' chances of winning Senate control. The Democrats Adam Hamilton in [[Kansas]] and Troy Jackson in [[Maine]] each gained a good deal of ground, and the market now lists both as predicted flips. The projected Senate count is now 53-47, up from 52-48, with Kansas newly predicted to flip, and the result is that Democrats gain control.
summaries.governor: In [[Georgia]], the Democrat Keisha Lance Bottoms gained ground in a moderate move, and the market treats the race as a predicted flip. The Democrat in [[Nevada]], Aaron Ford, lost some ground in a moderate slip, though that race is also a predicted flip. Elsewhere, Republican chances eased in a moderate way in [[Texas]], where Greg Abbott leads, and in Florida, where Byron Donalds leads.
summaries.house: Polymarket odds show Democrats, still favoured to win the House, edging up slightly in their chances of taking control. The projected seat count recently changed to 240-195, up from 238-197, which would mean Democrats gain control. [[SC-01 (Mount Pleasant & Summerville)]] and [[WI-01 (Kenosha & Racine)]] are newly predicted flips. In [[NC-13 (Fuquay-Varina & Sanford)]], the Republican Brad Knott saw a sharp rise in their chances against the Democrat Paul Barringer.
